title: Primary turns calculation
description: Essential: Correctly applies the transformer voltage ratio to compute n1 from given voltages and n2.

title: Secondary II power via conservation
description: Essential: Correctly states the final output power P2 using power conservation (P_input = P1 + P2).

title: Power in resistor R1
description: Important: Calculates the power dissipated in R1 using the correct formula with V2 and R1.

title: Input power from primary
description: Important: Calculates the total input power using the primary voltage and current readings.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (Volts, Amps, Ohms, Watts) throughout calculations.

title: Sign or ratio reversal
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly inverts the transformer turns ratio (e.g., n1/n2 = V2/V1).

title: Power arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error in the final subtraction (P_input - P1) for P2.
